acquisition_method.evidence: MS was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode (DDA) with full MS scans from 300 to 1600 m/z (resolution 60,000) with the polysiloxane ion at 371.10124 m/z as lock mass.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Disulfide bonds were reduced by adding 10 mM TCEP at 37 °C for 30 min, and free sulfhydryl groups were alkylated using 15 mM IAA at room temperature, in the dark, for 30 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Disulfide bonds were reduced by adding 10 mM TCEP at 37 °C for 30 min, and free sulfhydryl groups were alkylated using 15 mM IAA at room temperature, in the dark, for 30 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: For proteolysis, 100 µg of protein from each sample was processed using the S-Trap protocol (Protifi) with a 20:1 protein-to-trypsin ratio.

collision_energy.evidence: For fragmentation, the 15 most intense ions (above the threshold ion count of 5E3) were chosen at a normalized collision energy (nCE) of 27% in each cycle, following each survey scan.

instrument.evidence: All samples were analyzed using an UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano-UHPLC system coupled to a QExactive HF mass spectrometer, with 1 µg of peptide used for each analysis.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Z-scoring was performed with the raw abundance values obtained and normalized by the Proteome Discoverer 2.5 software (Thermo Scientific) to create and visualize the heatmap.
